description: Generate a D&D encounter using the declared prompt and optional structured fields. Entity text is free on every user plan, including Free. Portraits use the account's art preset: the default is free; a paid preset charges its Gold price, shown as portrait_gold, or falls back to the free default if unaffordable. Partner keys are billed from their wallet. Returns a job_id immediately; poll chargen_get_job for the entity_id and page_url. Pass collection_id to file it into your folder. Generated entries are public by default; change visibility in CharGen. User accounts only.

collection_id.description: Optional folder UUID owned by you; user accounts only. The finished entity is filed there on the first completed chargen_get_job poll.

difficultyTier.description: target difficulty in the chosen system, e.g. moderate or deadly

hazardIds.description: array of your hazard generation UUIDs

idempotency_key.description: Optional partner billing deduplication key. Retries with the same key avoid a second wallet debit, but can start another generation.

lootIds.description: array of your loot generation UUIDs

monsterIds.description: array of your monster generation UUIDs

npcIds.description: array of your NPC generation UUIDs

partyId.description: UUID of one of your parties (chargen_list_parties)

partySize.description: integer 1-10; optional with partyId (the party's size is used)

name: chargen_generate_encounter
title: Generate encounter
